content: {"conclusions":[{"claim":"The central scenario projects hybrid scale-to-zero as cheapest, but this is not an observed deployment saving.","evidence":"Projected operating cost table: Local only $46.486667/month, Local + cloud escalation $23.421607/month, Cloud every event $139.836067/month","evidence_class":"assumption","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Use hybrid scale-to-zero as the leading economic scenario, not as a purchasing recommendation or validated production claim.","caveat":"The ranking depends on assumed event volume, escalation, unresolved share, review labour, cold-start behaviour and inference time; real recognition accuracy is absent."},{"claim":"Review labour can dominate local-only operating cost.","evidence":"Sensitivity table: at 40 events/day, 30% escalated and 5 review minutes, Local only is $910.49/month versus Hybrid S2Z $193.84/month","evidence_class":"assumption","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Prioritise measuring escalation and staff review time before choosing local-only or hybrid.","caveat":"This is a scenario outcome, not measured staff workload or a forecast with calibrated probabilities."},{"claim":"A dedicated always-warm A100-80GB dominates cloud-using architecture costs in the scenario.","evidence":"Cloud container cost: dedicated always-warm projection $2.50 × 730 = $1,825/month; Projected operating cost table","evidence_class":"assumption","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Avoid proposing one warm GPU per kitchen without measured utilisation or a buyer-specific justification.","caveat":"The GPU choice and 730-hour convention are assumptions; only the listed hourly rate is vendor-sourced."},{"claim":"Shared serving can dilute fixed GPU cost, but multi-kitchen feasibility and bills are unmeasured.","evidence":"Shared cloud serving projection table: Hybrid $23.211667/kitchen/month and Cloud every event $55.611667/kitchen/month at N=200","evidence_class":"assumption","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Present shared serving as a path-to-production hypothesis requiring a multi-tenant load and billing test.","caveat":"Even division by N, 20% headroom, serial-service capacity and excluded CPU/memory/networking do not establish concurrency, queue latency, tenant allocation or actual cost."},{"claim":"Inference-only costing omits substantial paid container time in the central cold-burst scenario.","evidence":"Cloud container cost: 373.397603 paid seconds/burst costing $0.259304 versus $0.001042 inference-only, about 249 times less","evidence_class":"assumption","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Keep start, weight-load, idle and scale-down time in the economic model and demo narration.","caveat":"The 249× ratio is scenario-specific: inference, scale-down and one event per burst are assumptions, not a general cloud-cost multiplier."},{"claim":"One smoke app's measured bill was about 72× its reconstructed query-inference estimates.","evidence":"Measured smoke example: bill $0.08471859 versus three estimates totalling $0.0011826; resource report includes L4, CPU, memory and egress","evidence_class":"measured-infrastructure","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Use provider billing rather than query-price reconstruction for development expenditure.","caveat":"This is one small Qwen smoke run and does not establish a 72× ratio for other models, workloads or production deployments."},{"claim":"The UNO Q measurement covers only the existing template baseline, not learned-model feasibility.","evidence":"Measured basis / UNO Q baseline: 13.5% of one CPU core in a 5-second sample, 77.5 MiB container memory, 8 preview frames in 8 seconds; 'No learned model has run on the UNO Q.'","evidence_class":"measured-infrastructure","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Do not claim on-board learned recognition, production throughput or power feasibility in the pitch.","caveat":"The CPU and preview-rate samples are extremely short; classifier latency, processing fps, peak replay memory, thermals and power remain unmeasured."},{"claim":"Real-shelf recognition and the principal operating-cost drivers remain unvalidated.","evidence":"Status and Measurement plan / Which measurement replaces which assumption: real accuracy, 12 events/day, 10% escalation, 10% unresolved, review time and false stock changes require person-validated recordings and staff logs","evidence_class":"real-shelf-validation","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Gate deployment and continuous replenishment claims on a labelled real-shelf pilot; retain the current replenishment proposal as simulated and pending team agreement.","caveat":"No validated recordings of the team's products exist, so neither synthetic results nor infrastructure smoke tests can establish product recognition, event precision/recall or safe autonomy."},{"claim":"Modal prices are current provider list-rate inputs, not independent evidence.","evidence":"Verified Modal rates table: T4 $0.59/hour through H100 $3.95/hour and CPU $0.0473/hour, read from `modal billing rates --json`","evidence_class":"vendor-claim","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Use these rates for reproducible scenarios and timestamp them; do not describe them as independently verified production prices.","caveat":"Provider CLI output confirms vendor-published rates only; future rates, discounts, production CPU allocation and actual billed configuration may differ."},{"claim":"Recorded development infrastructure expenditure is small but incomplete and separate from operating cost.","evidence":"Development expenditure: 08:00 snapshot $1.60555660 measured Modal expenditure; combined figure $1.67677660 including $0.07122 assumption-priced Verda usage","evidence_class":"measured-infrastructure","supported":"partly","decision_informed":"Report hackathon cloud spend transparently and keep it out of monthly kitchen economics.","caveat":"The Modal report is growing and includes running jobs; one Verda probe is absent, Verda prices are assumptions, and labour, hardware and other development costs are excluded."},{"claim":"The cost model and its reproducibility commands are implementation assertions requiring coordinator verification.","evidence":"Status: stdlib-only `experiments/sustainability/cost_model.py`; final Run commands for cost_model.py and pytest","evidence_class":"code-claim","supported":"partly","decision_informed":"Have the coordinator run the model and tests before citing regenerated figures in the submission.","caveat":"The document supplies commands and outputs but no independent test-run result, coverage report or reconciliation against a production invoice."},{"claim":"The documented uncertain/manual paths are relevant controls, but code inspection is not recognition or robustness evidence.","evidence":"Existing uncertain and manual paths: `classify`, `observe`, board-page offline/unsure behaviour and manual low-stock controls","evidence_class":"code-claim","supported":"partly","decision_informed":"Use these paths in the exception demo while avoiding claims of measured false-change suppression or safe end-to-end recovery.","caveat":"Read-only inspection does not test duplicate frames, stale frames, disconnect recovery, malformed cloud responses, duplicate reorders or real staff operation."}],"unsupported_or_overstated":["'Verified Modal rates' is overstated if read as independent verification: the evidence is provider CLI documentation/output and therefore a vendor claim.","'Existing confirmation and uncertain gates suppress untrusted changes' goes beyond inspection if presented as an empirical result; only a suppression mechanism is described, and its false-confirmed-change rate is unmeasured.","'No option permits a vision model or language model to place an order directly' is an architecture/code assertion, not a demonstrated conformance or adversarial-test result in this output.","Calling one event per cold burst 'conservative' is valid only for the stated cost model; it is not universally conservative across retries, overlapping containers, autoscaling replicas, failures or provider metering behaviour.","The 'combined development figure' must not be described as total project development cost: billing is still growing, one token record is missing, Verda pricing is assumed, and labour and hardware are excluded.","The roughly 72× smoke-bill ratio and roughly 249× cold-burst ratio must not be generalised into typical production cloud multipliers.","The 1 preview-frame/second figure should not be presented as a steady-state board workload measurement or classifier throughput; it comes from 8 frames in 8 seconds.","Any use of the cost tables to recommend deployment, validate continuous observation/scheduled ordering, or claim buyer savings would exceed the evidence; the document itself correctly disclaims those uses."],"repetitive_or_low_value":["Drop the full 27-row sensitivity grid from the team summary; retain the central case, one labour-dominated stress case and a link to the JSON/report.","Drop the 14-row per-app development billing ledger from the summary; retain the measured Modal total, its incompleteness caveat and the resource breakdown for the single smoke example.","Replace the full GPU SKU price list with the A100-80GB scenario rate and any GPU actually used in the smoke measurements; link the rest.","Consolidate repeated statements that every operating figure is a projection into one prominent caveat per table or section.","Move the shared-service GPU-second arithmetic and 5.14% utilisation calculation to an appendix; retain only the scenario costs and the absence of concurrency/queue evidence.","Condense the eight-part measurement plan into the real-shelf accuracy/event gate, staff-review measurement, UNO Q feasibility test and cloud billing/latency test.","Remove detailed board-page rendering and setup-guidance descriptions from the economics summary; retain only uncertain/no-stock-change, offline/manual fallback and gateway-controlled purchasing.","Omit token-snapshot bookkeeping minutiae except the recorded amount, missing probe and assumption-priced status."],"negative_results":["No learned model has run on the UNO Q; local learned-model memory, latency, throughput, thermal and power feasibility are unknown.","No person-validated real-shelf recordings establish recognition of the team's products, empty/low/full states, unknown handling, false confirmed stock changes or event precision/recall.","The two-photo template baseline tracks slot state, not free product identity, and its CPU/memory footprint cannot be extrapolated to a learned recogniser.","Real event volume, escalation fraction, cloud unresolved share, review minutes and unnecessary reorder attempts are unmeasured.","No production Gemma latency distribution, deployed scale-down behaviour, events-per-cold-burst measurement or overlapping-window billing credit exists.","Shared-service concurrency, queue p50/p95, production CPU/memory/network costs and actual multi-kitchen bills are unmeasured; 5.14% utilisation is only a serial-capacity sanity check.","The development billing snapshot is not final, and recorded Verda usage is explicitly incomplete.","The smoke and billing results establish infrastructure expenditure only; they do not establish real-shelf accuracy, production performance or deployment feasibility.","Under the central assumptions, local-only is not automatically cheapest because review labour can exceed hybrid cloud cost; conversely, the hybrid advantage is not empirically established."],"open_question_worth_a_run":["Run a time-boxed real-kitchen pilot on the physical UNO Q with person-labelled, session-split recordings of the actual products, including empty/low/full, unknown items, occlusion, darkness, duplicates, stale frames and disconnects. Replay the identical events through local and cloud paths, measure product/event accuracy, false confirmed changes, escalation and unresolved rates, capture-to-decision latency, board peak RSS/CPU/fps/power, and timestamp staff reviews; join resulting gateway audit run_ids to count false or duplicate reorder attempts.","Deploy the intended cloud recogniser in both scale-to-zero and warm/shared configurations and replay measured arrival bursts at several concurrency levels. Meter container starts, weight loads, queue/inference/response p50/p95, events per burst, idle and scale-down time, replicas, paid GPU seconds, CPU, memory and egress, then reconcile the totals with provider billing and rerun the cost model."]}
